title: Convergence analysis of Schwarz-like methods for degenerate elliptic-parabolic equations
summary: Convergence is proven for Schwarz-like methods applied to degenerate elliptic-parabolic equations with a $p$-structure. This family of PDEs, e.g., arises when modelling nonlinear diffusion processes. The Schwarz-like approximation methods are based on decomposing the space-time domain into overlapping subdomains, which enables parallel implementations. The methods are derived by introducing a pseudo-time component and applying time integrators of splitting type, which are time stepped towards infinity.
